user.title: EG4 Inverter (Local Dongle)
user.description: Connect directly to the EG4/LuxPower WiFi dongle over your LAN — no cloud. Enter the details yourself, or scan your network for the dongle.

menu_options.scan: Scan my network for the dongle

connect.title: EG4 dongle connection
connect.description: The dongle answers on TCP port 8000. The serials are printed on the dongle and inverter. {scan_result}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the dongle at that IP and port. Check the address and that nothing else is holding the dongle's single session.
error.no_data: Connected, but no telemetry arrived. The dongle may be busy, or the serials may be wrong. Try again in a moment.
error.serial_mismatch: The dongle reported inverter serial {reported}. Enter that serial instead.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

init.title: EG4 local options
init.description: The dongle is single-session and flaky; polling harder than 30 s is discouraged.

data.expose_provisional: Expose provisional BMS fields (cell temps, cycle count, pack current). These are read correctly but their scale/meaning is reasoned, not confirmed.
